title: OnePush Notification Platform
subtitle: Event-Driven Web Push Notification Platform
summary: Modular event-driven Laravel platform for website registration, automated Web Push notification delivery, integrated with OneSignal and Pagar.me.
overview: SaaS system for domain registration and automated Web Push notification delivery triggered by system events, integrated with subscription payment gateway.
responsibilities: Developed event-driven architecture (Event Listeners & Jobs) in Laravel.
Integrated OneSignal RESTful API for mass push notification delivery.
Integrated Pagar.me gateway for recurring billing.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Delivering mass push notifications asynchronously without blocking HTTP client requests.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Decoupled notification dispatch using background Laravel queue jobs.

metrics: Instant Web Push notification delivery without impacting HTTP request latency
